research_task.title: Replay a complete hash-pinned six-cell bundle

summary: A fresh in-scope audit found that the advertised complete hash-pinned six-cell replay bundle was not delivered: only the research brief and three review-authored files existed, so no replay or historical-output comparison was possible.

value_assessment.novelty: Relative to the directly linked prior contribution, this independently reproduces the missing-delivery obstruction in a new attempt and shows that the advertised complete immutable bundle did not materialize; it adds a fresh brief digest plus independent inventory, filename, embedded-payload, and alternate-stream checks, but does not change any historical checker claim.
value_assessment.evidence: Two in-scope recursive enumerations using distinct filesystem interfaces found only the pre-existing 9,803-byte research brief and three review-authored files; the brief digest is 52fdefc54ad93fbc9b6c27d515396c3000cf6359079ce25fd92ed100e75298ba, and checks found no manifest candidate, JavaScript file, PowerShell file, code fence, file-extension mention, digest, expected-output heading, or alternate payload stream.
value_assessment.falsifier: An audit of the directory snapshot predating the review that reveals a supplied hash manifest, both replayers, all referenced original and malformed inputs, and the unabridged expected-output manifest—or an attributable embedded or alternate-stream payload missed by the recorded checks—would overturn this missing-delivery result.

claims.statement: Within the supplied current-directory snapshot, the minimum files needed for the requested six-cell replay were absent; specifically, the first prerequisite absent by role was a supplied hash manifest, and both replayers, all original and malformed inputs, and the expected-output manifest were also absent.
claims.evidence_summary: The claim depends only on the completeness of the permitted directory snapshot and ordinary filesystem visibility. Two recursive enumerations found only the pre-existing research brief plus three review-authored artifacts. Filename, content, reparse-point, and alternate-stream checks found no hidden or embedded bundle. A known objection is that files may exist outside this attempt directory, which is outside the claim scope.
claims.verification_method: Repeat a hidden-inclusive recursive inventory inside the attempt directory, separate review-authored files from the earlier brief by timestamps, hash the brief, search all filenames for manifest and expected-output candidates and replayer extensions, and inspect the brief for fenced payloads, digests, filename-like references, and alternate streams.

limitations: The result establishes absence only from the supplied permitted directory, not nonexistence elsewhere.
No replayer execution, determinism test, raw or normalized output comparison, or historical claim authentication occurred.
No canonical filenames were supplied, so the first missing file is identified only by its required role as the hash manifest.
The result has no bearing on the truth of the Riemann Hypothesis.
failed_approaches: The planned hash verification and replay could not begin because no supplied hash manifest, replayer, input fixture, or expected-output manifest was present.
Adversarial checks for differently named candidates, fenced embedded payloads, digest text, and alternate streams found no recoverable bundle.
next_actions: Deliver one immutable offline directory with a top-level SHA-256 manifest naming and hashing both replayers, every original and malformed six-cell input, and the unabridged machine-readable expected-output manifest.
After verifying that delivery, run every replayer and case twice and preserve raw and normalized claim-by-claim comparisons for acceptance, ownership, mutation, and correction results.

proposed_tasks.title: Replay the actually delivered hash-pinned six-cell bundle
proposed_tasks.objective: Verify a supplied top-level digest manifest, then execute both preserved replayers twice against every manifest-listed original and malformed input and compare raw and normalized outputs with every expected claim.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The current review is blocked solely before replay because the advertised payload was absent; a complete self-describing delivery makes each requested historical claim decidable.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: Every manifest-listed digest verifies, both runs of every replayer-case pairing are deterministic, and each acceptance, ownership, mutation, and correction claim is classified as an exact match or precise contradiction.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Report the first manifest omission, digest mismatch, ambiguous expected field, execution failure, nondeterministic byte, normalization discrepancy, or expected-count mismatch with the affected file and claim role.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Work offline in the delivered directory, verify the top-level manifest before execution, inspect inputs without modification, execute every pairing twice, hash raw outputs, apply only manifest-defined normalization, and compare every named expected field.
